title: Symplectic completion over smooth affine algebras
summary: In this article, we prove the following results:\\ \noindent \text{(1).} Let $R$ be a smooth affine algebra of dimension $3$ over an algebraically closed field $K$ with $3!\in K$, then we show that $\Um_4(R)=e_1\Sp_4(R)$ and $\Um_4(R [X])=e_1\Sp_4(R[X])$. \noindent \text{(2).} We also show that if $R$ is a smooth affine algebra of dimension $4$ over an algebraically closed field $K$ with $4!\in K$, and assume that $\W_E(R)$ is divisible, then $\Um_3(R)=e_1\SL_3(R)$.
